portada.title: Ca la Marxanta · Handmade carquinyolis from Horta, Barcelona
portada.desc: Carquinyolis, Petarrons and Porretes, 100% handmade with artisan butter and Catalan hazelnuts and almonds. A Catalan tradition born in the Horta neighbourhood in 2018.
portada.og_title: Ca la Marxanta · Handmade carquinyolis from Horta
portada.og_desc: We don't want to sell you a product, we want you to enjoy it.
portada.hero_alt: Hands working the dough in the workshop
portada.hero_titol:
We make carquinyolis.
We keep our tradition alive.
portada.hero_subtitol: Every recipe grows out of respect for the ingredients, for time, and for a way of doing things that has barely changed over the years.
portada.historia_alt: Working the dough by hand with a wooden rolling pin
portada.historia_titol: It all began in 2018, in the Horta neighbourhood
portada.historia_text: Behind every carquinyoli there is a brave decision: to back a traditional craft, to bring a recipe back, and to give it the time it takes to do things properly. That is how Ca la Marxanta was born, and how it keeps growing.
portada.historia_lema: We don't want to sell you a product, we want you to enjoy it.
portada.obrador_alt: Floured balls of dough ready for the oven
portada.obrador_text_1: We work with 100% artisan butter and with hazelnuts and almonds from Catalonia. The recipe draws on carquinyolis that are crunchier and moreish than the usual ones.
portada.obrador_text_2b: one by one before they go into the oven
portada.obrador_text_2c: . That way they don't come out slice-shaped like the more common version: it is what sets them apart, and it is how it should be done.
portada.cita_2:
Every morning begins the same way.
And we love that.
portada.pilars_eyebrow: The difference is in the details
pilars: Hazelnuts and almonds from Catalonia, artisan butter and organic lemon zest. Local produce of the highest quality.
Hand-cut, one by one. No rush, with the same care as always.
A way of working rooted in the Horta neighbourhood, kept alive because someone decided to protect it.
portada.cita_3: We don't rush time. Because good flavour was never in a hurry.
portada.colleccio_titol: Some recipes never change. They only get better with time.
families: The classic crunch, cut one by one. The one that goes with coffee, tea and sweet wines.
Box of almond Porretes del Padrí
Carquinyoli sticks for breakfast and afternoon tea. The same heart, in stick form.
100% artisan butter biscuits. So good that everyone asked whether they were pets de monja.
portada.cita_4: Every recipe has a character of its own.
portada.cita_5: Because the best moments are always shared.
portada.final_titol: Some crafts survive thanks to the people who believe in them
portada.final_text: Some recipes are passed down through generations. And there are small pleasures that still taste exactly as they did many years ago. That is Ca la Marxanta.

historia.title: Our story · Ca la Marxanta
historia.desc: The story of Ca la Marxanta: a workshop making handmade carquinyolis, born in Barcelona's Horta neighbourhood in 2018.
historia.h1: The best stories begin with a decision
historia.lead: The decision to do things the way they have always been done: with time, with care, and with real ingredients.
historia.cita: Traditions don't survive by chance. They survive because someone decides to protect them.
historia.nom_text: A marxanta is someone who goes to market, who travels the roads carrying good produce from one place to another. The name evokes that old, local trade: today our carquinyolis travel from the Horta workshop to tables across Catalonia.
historia.barri_text: Horta is one of the most characterful neighbourhoods in Barcelona, and it has always held on to its identity. You will even see people walking proudly in T-shirts that read «Sóc d'Horta» — I'm from Horta. Sometimes it doesn't feel like Barcelona at all: the atmosphere is quite different.
historia.final_text: Because we believe the best traditions deserve to stay alive.

obrador.title: The workshop · Ca la Marxanta
obrador.desc: How we make our carquinyolis: six handmade steps, cut one by one, with local ingredients.
obrador.lead: We're not trying to make more. We're trying to make it better.
passos: We choose hazelnuts and almonds from Catalonia, artisan butter and organic lemon zest.
We work the ingredients in exactly the right proportions, with no unnecessary additives.
We shape the dough by hand, with the same care as always.
We cut each carquinyoli one by one before baking. That is why they don't come out slice-shaped.
The bake is what gives them their characteristic crunch.
We pack them carefully so they reach your home in perfect condition.
obrador.cita: We believe in time, in hands, and in respect for a recipe.
ingredients: From Catalonia. They give our carquinyolis their deep, distinctive flavour.
100% artisan: the heart of the Petarrons and their unmistakable texture.
A fresh, aromatic note, present in almost every recipe.
It binds the dough and gives it structure; in the Petarrons we use the white.
For a measured sweetness, never excessive.
The base of the whole family, worked with time and patience.
obrador.final_text: Explore the whole collection and find your favourite.
